model: count_0=g(lc0); count_p=H0(count_{p-1},lc_{p-1},lc_p,p); raw_p=InvLUT[lc_p]+count_p (mod 256). H0 takes the 0-based ply p as 4th input; lc=0xeb marks a 3-byte move (same count for all 3 bytes). Some moves are bracketed [M,X1..Xk,M] (k=1..3) with cipher-transparent X bytes. The game-ending Pop token uses the move-number count (plies/2). 0xeb triple: b0=InvLUT[0xeb]+cnt; b1=InvLUT[X1]+P1(cnt,X1,p+1) with X1=(promo-2)<<6|to; b2=InvLUT[X2]+P2(c1,X2,p+2) with X2=from.
source: ChessBase 26.8 oracle: 5760 generated games over all 960 positions, byte-exact alignment incl. castling segments and 0xeb underpromotion triples. Harvested 2026-07-26 from full move trajectories (5702/5760 games strictly consistent).
